The solution:

```python
from pathlib import Path

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.hist(data["score"], bins=4)
ax.set_title("Score distribution")
ax.set_xlabel("Score")

fig.savefig("chart.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)

path = Path("chart.png")
print(path.exists())
print(path.stat().st_size > 0)
print(ax.get_title())
```
